Main Input: Spatial transcriptomics count matrix with spatial coordinates
Main Use in This Topic: normalize measured spatial transcriptomics expression by modeling library-size effects while preserving spatial biology when assumptions hold
Main Output: normalized expression matrix for downstream spatial analyses
Closest Alternatives: Backbone baseline context: Scanpy; Seurat/sctransform; scran/scater; Giotto; Squidpy
Key Difference: Dedicated spatial-aware normalization method-paper row; baseline workflow packages remain context only and are not counted as candidate methods.
Evidence Note: Direct evidence: PubMed verifies PMID 40301877 and DOI 10.1186/s13059-025-03565-y; Bioconductor provides the code/access route. Layer 2 synthesis: signal-removal caveat and backbone context.
Best First Choice When: Consider when the active task is spatial-aware normalization of an already measured spatial expression matrix and library-size effects may be spatially structured.
Do Not Start With This When: Consider backbone context when the task is routine workflow normalization/HVG preprocessing, and use Panel Design when the task is pre-assay gene-panel selection.
Scientific-risk Caveat: Normalization can remove or attenuate true spatial biology if technical depth effects are not separable from real tissue structure.
